summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for contrast/hover updates, expiry-aware F&O fields, sticky custom projection lifecycle, dynamic custom-script parsing, and Top 4 regression on public preview URL.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested scope; keep regression coverage from test_fno_custom_position_expiry_flow.py in future runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:list_custom_positions swallows all refresh exceptions (`except Exception: continue`), which can silently hide failures and drop cards from UI without user feedback.
App.js:closeCustomProjection ignores API errors silently, so users get no visible error when close action fails.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary basic users/positions during pytest; cleanup executed in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest passed 25/25. Newly added regression verifies: dynamic custom script parse (no Script not supported regression), minutes_to_expiry + expiry_risk presence, credit deduction on custom-position create for basic users, sticky list alert fields including EXIT_URGENT_LOSS behavior, and close/removal lifecycle.
rca of the issue: No functional defects reproduced in requested features. Two transient UI automation failures were test-timing artifacts (close clicked while create call still saving and count-based assertion with existing cards). Mitigation: wait for submit state reset and verify close by specific position id selector.
